candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion in the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order 503s, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway checkout 502s (~2s).
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres server-side metrics or pool wait-time data; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing at postgres.save_order with pool size 5, idle 0, and DependencyUnavailable, propagating to order 503s and gateway 502s at ~2s. Gateway metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2406ms. Pool exhaustion is the best-supported bounded cause; server-side pool metrics are still needed to confirm.
missing_evidence: Postgres server metrics: active connections, max_connections, and pool wait/acquire latency for the order service
Order service connection pool configuration and saturation metrics over the incident window
